what.a: A page in your name that gathers your links, your services and your contact buttons, and tracks what it brings you: visits, taps, contacts and where they come from.

who.a: For local independents (coaches, hairdressers, estate agents, tutors, therapists…) and content creators who want one link to share.

trial.q: How does the trial work? Do I need a card?
trial.a: The trial lasts 14 days and requires a bank card. Nothing is charged during the trial; after it, the subscription is €19 a month. Without a subscription at the end of the trial, your page stays online for 7 days, then goes offline.

cancel.a: Yes, from “Manage my subscription”, in a few clicks. You keep access until the end of the paid period.

data.a: It stays yours. Visit tracking uses no cookies and keeps no IP address. If you stop, your data is kept; if you delete your account, it is erased.

social.q: Does it work with WhatsApp and Instagram?
social.a: Yes. The WhatsApp button opens the chat with a ready message, and the Instagram link in your bio can carry its own source, so you know how many visits come from Instagram.

domain.q: Can I use my own domain name?
domain.a: Not yet: your page lives at thesessionlink.com/your-name. Custom domains are coming soon.

support.a: On WhatsApp or by email, from the bottom of this page or from your account. A person answers.
